title: Tensor-BEKK: Conditional Covariance Modeling and Inference for Tensor-Valued Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2609.18157v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern economic and financial data are increasingly organized as multiway arrays, with observations indexed simultaneously by geographic regions, industrial sectors, asset categories, and other economic characteristics. Representing such data as tensor-valued time series preserves their intrinsic multiway structure. Although substantial effort has been devoted to modeling the conditional mean of tensor-valued time series, comparatively less attention has been paid to their conditional covariance dynamics. The latter remains challenging because unrestricted multivariate covariance models involve many parameters and substantial computational cost. To address these challenges, we propose the Tensor-BEKK (T-BEKK) model, a tensor-structured BEKK specification that retains the positive definite covariance recursion for the vectorized process while imposing Kronecker structures on the intercept and the ARCH and GARCH coefficient matrices. translated_title: Tensor-BEKK：张量值时间序列的条件协方差建模与推断
translated_abstract: 现代经济与金融数据越来越多地以多维数组的形式组织，其观测值同时由地理区域、行业部门、资产类别以及其他经济特征进行索引。将此类数据表示为张量值时间序列能够保留其固有的多维结构。尽管在张量值时间序列的条件均值建模方面已投入了大量精力，但其条件协方差动态却相对较少受到关注。后者仍然具有挑战性，因为无约束的多元协方差模型涉及大量参数和可观的计算成本。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了张量-BEKK（T-BEKK）模型，这是一种张量结构化的BEKK设定，它在保留向量化过程的正定协方差递推的同时，对截距项以及ARCH和GARCH系数矩阵施加了Kronecker结构。
tldr: 提出Tensor-BEKK（T-BEKK）模型，通过在BEKK结构上施加Kronecker约束来建模张量值时间序列的条件协方差动态，在保证协方差矩阵正定性的同时大幅降低参数数量与计算成本。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Tensor-BEKK (T-BEKK) model, which imposes Kronecker structures on the BEKK specification to model conditional covariance dynamics of tensor-valued time series while preserving positive definiteness and substantially reducing parameters and computational cost.
